title: BF Document Schema v4.1.1
description: Optimized schema with strict conditions, flexible option sources, floating block improvements, and style safety.

data.description: Central reactive data tree. All bindings read/write to this object.

i18n.description: Internationalization dictionary. Keys are locale codes (e.g., 'en', 'zh-CN'), values are objects with translation key-value pairs. Labels, titles etc. may reference keys via '@:path' syntax.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks for document-level actions (e.g., onMount, onSubmit, onChange).

formBlock.description: Embedded form used within sheet views. Not available as a standalone page content block.

readOnly.description: Render the form in read-only mode: all fields are disabled and submit/reset actions are hidden. Intended for reviewing documents under approval (审核中表单只读).

widthMode.description: How the sheet adapts to its container width. 'fixed' keeps natural column widths (wide containers leave empty space on the right); 'stretch' distributes the extra container width to stretchable columns (respecting maxWidth) so the sheet fills the container.

rowBind.description: Dynamic row source from data array. When set, rows are generated from this binding instead of using static 'rows'. If both rows and rowBind are absent, an empty table is displayed.

rowTemplate.description: Template for each generated row. Uses column indices or field paths.

cellMapping.description: Map column index (string) to cell definition. Uses mappedSheetCell (column property is excluded as it's the key).

rows.description: Static rows, used when rowBind is not defined. Can be omitted for an empty table.

style.description: Paragraph style fallback applied to header content when a paragraph does not define its own style.
Paragraph style fallback applied to footer content when a paragraph does not define its own style.

text.description: Static text, or fallback when bind is not resolved.

bind.description: Data binding. When both text and bind are present, bind takes precedence and text serves as default.

x.description: Horizontal position. Number for absolute points, string percentage relative to page width.

y.description: Vertical position. Number for absolute points, string percentage relative to page height.

mappedSheetCell.description: Used in cellMapping where column index is the key; column property is omitted.

printConfig.description: Printer/export-specific instructions that do not affect screen rendering.

conditional.description: Conditional style rules that override properties based on data conditions.

style.description: Override style properties when condition is met. Only listed properties are allowed.
Only these character properties can be overridden conditionally.

trigger.description: Lifecycle event that fires the hook.

type.description: Action type. 'api' calls an HTTP endpoint, 'function' invokes a registered function, 'dispatch' triggers an internal event.

config.description: Configuration for the action. Validation is left to the business logic layer.
